kind: configurable signed native library overlay and dlopen native extension overlay

configuration.lock: docs/guest-tools-lock.json libraries[] entries (group, base, archive, sha256, files[member,guestPath]) and extensions[] entries (source, guestPath)
configuration.groups: HARMONY_GUEST_LIB_GROUPS (default for self builds: common,media,extensions; empty/none for store builds)
configuration.bindings: scripts/build/harmonyos_guest_extras.py writes entry/src/main/cpp/guest-libs.inc; poc.c packaged[] includes it
configuration.storeBuilds: HARMONY_SELF_BUILD!=1 -> no libraries/extensions staged and stale overlay files removed

measuredHapSizes.note: native libraries are stored uncompressed in the HAP, so the HAP delta equals the raw .so bytes
